column1: # Reviewed skill budget exceptions.
# name|description characters|root lines|reference file|reason
# A skill above the budget is a reviewed exception until the row changes. The
# measurements are the ones that were reviewed: a row whose measurements no
# longer match this record fails the check, because updating an exception is a
# review action and never an automatic pass.
# The upstream bytes are not rewritten, because the lock's value is that the
# deployed bytes are upstream's. A description above the budget is therefore
# kept and reviewed, not edited.
# description characters  the length of the description a client reads, with a
#                        folded or literal frontmatter block read as its joined
#                        prose.
# root lines             the number of lines of the skill's root document.
# reference file         whether the skill ships a reference file beside the
#                        root document. A root document with a reference file
#                        may be longer, because the detail lives beside it.
